judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed with && instead of ||, so it is true only for users who are simultaneously team admin and team owner, silently inverting the OR that the variable's own name declares. A team admin who is not also the team owner (and a team owner without a separate admin membership) calling viewer.bookings.addGuests on a team booking is rejected with FORBIDDEN you_do_not_have_permission, so the intended 'admin or owner may manage guests' permission path is dead code — and the diff ships no test that would have caught it.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both admin and owner. The subsequent permission gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` will therefore reject team admins who aren’t also owners (and owners who aren’t also admins), contradicting the variable name and typical intended logic (`admin || owner`). No tests are added in the diff to cover these roles for `viewer.bookings.addGuests`.
